svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="T_Txx3Xaxb4ICrfqFrLV"> <mxGraphModel dx="857" dy="-603" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
skinparam actorStyle awesome
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor #F5EEFF
 BorderColor #7C3AED
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 11
}
skinparam actor {
 BackgroundColor #EDE0FF
 BorderColor #7C3AED
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 12
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam package {
 BackgroundColor #FAF7FF
 BorderColor #C4A8F0
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam arrow {
 Color #7C3AED
 FontColor #7C3AED
 FontSize 10
}

left to right direction

' ── Actors ───────────────────────────────────────
actor \"Admin\" as Admin #LightSteelBlue
actor \"Teacher\" as Teacher #PaleGreen
actor \"Student\" as Student #LightSalmon
actor \"Dlib AI Engine\" as Dlib #Plum
actor \"Gate Scanner\" as Gate #LightGray

rectangle \"Face Recognition Module\" {

 package \"Face Enrollment\" {
 usecase \"Enroll Student\nFace (Admin)\" as UC_AdminEnroll
 usecase \"Enroll Own\nFace (Self)\" as UC_SelfEnroll
 usecase \"Capture Face\nImage (Base64)\" as UC_Capture
 usecase \"Extract 128-d\nDlib Embedding\" as UC_Extract
 usecase \"Store Embedding\nin Database\" as UC_Store
 }

 package \"Face Login\" {
 usecase \"Face Recognition\nLogin\" as UC_FaceLogin
 usecase \"Compare Face\nwith All Embeddings\" as UC_Compare
 usecase \"Generate JWT\nTokens on Match\" as UC_JWT
 usecase \"Reject Unrecognized\nFace\" as UC_Reject
 }

 package \"Lecture Attendance\" {
 usecase \"Teacher Marks\nAttendance Manually\" as UC_Manual
 usecase \"Update Attendance\nSummary & %\" as UC_Summary
 usecase \"Trigger Short\nAttendance Alert\" as UC_Alert
 }

 package \"Campus Gate Attendance\" {
 usecase \"Gate Camera\nCaptures Face\" as UC_GateCapture
 usecase \"Recognize Student\nat Gate\" as UC_GateRecog
 usecase \"Log Campus\nEntry / Exit\" as UC_GateLog
 usecase \"Filter Duplicate\nEntries (5 min)\" as UC_Duplicate
 usecase \"Manual Override\nby Admin\" as UC_Override
 }
}

' ── Admin Associations ───────────────────────────
Admin --> UC_AdminEnroll
Admin --> UC_Override

' ── Teacher Associations ─────────────────────────
Teacher --> UC_Manual
Teacher --> UC_Summary

' ── Student Associations ─────────────────────────
Student --> UC_SelfEnroll
Student --> UC_FaceLogin

' ── Dlib Engine Associations ─────────────────────
Dlib --> UC_Extract
Dlib --> UC_Compare
Dlib --> UC_GateRecog

' ── Gate Scanner Associations ────────────────────
Gate --> UC_GateCapture
Gate --> UC_GateLog

' ── Include / Extend ─────────────────────────────
UC_AdminEnroll .> UC_Capture : <<include>>
UC_SelfEnroll .> UC_Capture : <<include>>
UC_Capture .> UC_Extract : <<include>>
UC_Extract .> UC_Store : <<include>>

UC_FaceLogin .> UC_Compare : <<include>>
UC_Compare .> UC_JWT : <<extend>>
UC_Compare .> UC_Reject : <<extend>>

UC_GateCapture .> UC_GateRecog : <<include>>
UC_GateRecog .> UC_GateLog : <<include>>
UC_GateLog .> UC_Duplicate : <<include>>
UC_Override .> UC_GateLog : <<extend>>

UC_Manual .> UC_Summary : <<include>>
UC_Summary .> UC_Alert : <<extend>>

@enduml","format":"svg"}" id="14pVjtuajESJFR7WagT--21"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1511" width="413" x="20" y="1100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
